content: Can someone help review #38358? In this PR, I added some existing theorems from mathlib to 1000.yaml. For points that were previously controversial, I haven't made any changes yet. So it should be easy to review—about 10 minutes or so.

When convenient, I wanted to gently follow up on #38358. This is a small documentation-only PR updating docs/1000.yaml to record several theorems that have now been formalized. It was placed on the maintainer queue on May 3 and has been in maintainer-merge since then, so I just wanted to check whether anything else is needed from my side, in case it slipped through. Thanks very much!
It requires someone who works with representation theory to decide what to do with Maschke.
Isn't Maschke just the complement theorem applied recursively?
